description: Farwing (formerly OpenUUYC) remote desktop client, tracking stable and RC releases.

script: $release = $page | ConvertFrom-Json | Where-Object { -not $_.draft -and $_.tag_name -match '^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-rc[.-]\d+)?$' } | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { [version](($_.tag_name -replace '^v', '') -split '-')[0] } }, @{ Expression = { if ($_.tag_name -match '-rc') { 0 } else { 1 } } }, @{ Expression = { if ($_.tag_name -match '-rc[.-](\d+)$') { [int]$Matches[1] } else { 0 } } } -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $release) { throw 'No stable or RC release found.' }
if (-not $asset) { throw 'Windows x64 release asset not found.' }

notes: The Scoop package is the portable client. Installing the resident service from inside the app copies it to %ProgramFiles%\OpenUUYC.
Releases from 1.0.0-rc on can update that installed copy from a newer package with: OpenUUYC.exe update --silent --no-elevate (run from an elevated shell).
